articles.original_title: Minister McKnight tours Westridge Marine Terminal, showcasing Canada’s ability to build major energy infrastructure responsibly

articles.original_title: Joint Statement on the Anniversary of the Snapback of UN Restrictions on and related to Iran
articles.original_summary: “On September 27, 2025 (at 8:00 p.m. EDT), six United Nations Security Council resolutions (UNSCRs) – 1696 (2006), 1737 (2006), 1747 (2007), 1803 (2008), 1835 (2008), 1929 (2010) – returned into force pursuant to the completion of the snapback process.
